name: CWI Knowledge System — machine front door
description: Start here. Every dataset, entity, schema, and document a machine needs to discover, verify, and equip CWI software and catalog data. One canonical data layer.
idResolution: Fetch the @id URL directly; the body is JSON-LD. Human directory at https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/id/ . Entity map at https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/ai/entity-index.json .
provenancePolicy: Every claim carries source @id, dateCreated/dateModified, version, confidence (verified | owner_confirmed | claimed_unverified | incomplete), and status. 'verified' is used only for actually-verified facts.
relationshipPolicy: New relationships use only the controlled vocabulary at https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/graph/ontology.jsonld . No free-text relation names.

dataset.name: CWI catalog.json
dataset.description: 35-track machine-readable catalog (artist, tracks, placements, label presence).

dataset.name: CWI graph.json
dataset.description: Catalog knowledge graph: nodes + edges (music catalog; legacy snake_case rels grandfathered, see rel_legend).

dataset.name: CWI kit.json
dataset.description: Agent kit: citation guidance, verified proof points, claimed-but-unverified list.

dataset.name: CWI lineage registry (2026-10-01)
dataset.description: 34 fleet-retrofit product lineage records; provenance source for product entities.

dataset.name: entity-index.json
dataset.description: Every permanent @id mapped to type, name, and resolvable URL.

dataset.name: Relationship ontology
dataset.description: Controlled relationship vocabulary (16 terms); doubles as JSON-LD @context.

dataset.name: Retrofit packaging schema
dataset.description: JSON Schema: the per-product JSON-LD packaging template all retrofits conform to.
